title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh:
哗哗——哗哗——
黄河水汹涌地拍打着河岸，发出呼呼的响声。
河边上，有一只乌龟担忧地走来走去。
page_text_en:
Splash—splash—
The Yellow River surged, crashing against the riverbank with a roaring sound.
By the river, a turtle walked back and forth, looking worried.
summary_zh: 画面描绘了黄河水汹涌澎湃，一只乌龟在河岸边担忧地来回走动。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh:
太阳越升越高，岸边一个人影也没有。
这时，远处隐隐约约传来了一阵歌声：“嘿哟
嘿哟——左准绳，右规矩，山川河海都能量！”
page_text_en:
The sun rose higher and higher, but there was not a single person in sight along the shore.
At this moment, a song came faintly from afar: "Hei yo, hei yo — left with the plumb line, right with the square, mountains, rivers, and seas can all be measured!"
summary_zh: 太阳高照，河岸空无一人，一只乌龟在岸边担忧地走动，远处传来测量山川河海的歌声。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh:
有一群人推着小车走了过来。他们有的拿着水准和绳墨，有的拿着圆规和方矩，嘴里还大声地唱着歌儿。
原来，是大禹带领部下前来勘测地形，寻找治理洪水的办法。
不久前，洪水泛滥，淹没了田地，冲毁了房屋，人们生活痛苦极了。
page_text_en:
A group of people pushed a cart over. Some held leveling instruments and plumb lines, others held compasses and squares, and they sang loudly as they walked.
It turned out that Dayu was leading his subordinates to survey the terrain and find ways to control the floods.
Not long ago, floods had spread, drowning fields, destroying houses, and making people's lives extremely painful.
summary_zh: 大禹带领部下推着小车，手持测量工具，正在勘测地形以治理洪水。画面右侧的乌龟在岸边观望，背景是汹涌的洪水和山峦。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh:
大禹穿着粗布短衣，头戴斗笠，神情严肃，眼睛盯着奔涌的河水，好像在思考什么。

乌龟见了，在一旁好奇地望着大禹。
这时，有人上前向大禹请示：“大禹，咱们已经到了黄河边，接下来应该怎么做？”
乌龟听了，连忙回到河里离开了。
page_text_en:
Dayu was wearing rough cloth short clothes, wearing a conical hat, his expression serious, his eyes fixed on the surging river, as if thinking about something.

The turtle saw this and curiously watched Dayu from the side.
At this moment, someone approached Dayu and asked, "Dayu, we've already reached the Yellow River. What should we do next?"
The turtle, upon hearing this, hurried back into the river and left.
summary_zh: 大禹在黄河边勘察地形，神情严肃地思考治水方案，部下上前请示下一步行动，乌龟在一旁观望后游回河中。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh:
不一会儿，那只乌龟带来一个叫河伯的人来到岸边，远远地看着。
此时，大禹正让人在石头上系绳子，准备测量水的深度。
只见大禹手里握着绳子的顶端，把石头扔进了河里。
page_text_en:
In no time, the turtle brought a man named He Bo to the riverbank, who watched from a distance.
At this moment, Dayu was having someone tie a rope to a stone, preparing to measure the depth of the water.
Then, Dayu held the top of the rope and threw the stone into the river.
summary_zh: 乌龟带来河伯在岸边观望，大禹正带领部下用绳子和石头测量河水深度，准备治水。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh:
原来，石头沉到底后，绳子被河水浸湿的长度就是那一处河的深度。这时，河伯笑着对乌龟说：“走吧，咱们去和大禹聊聊治理洪水的事情。”
来到大禹身边，河伯问：“大禹，我听说你受命治理洪水，带着大家走遍千山万水，找寻治理洪水的方法，你找到了吗？”
“我总结了父亲鲧的治水方法，发现堵截洪水的效果不大。所以，我决定试试另一种方法——疏通河道，让洪水顺着河道流进东海。”大禹指着黄河说。
page_text_en:
Originally, the length of the rope soaked by the river water after the stone sank to the bottom was the depth of that section of the river. At this moment, the River God smiled at the turtle and said, "Let's go and talk to Dayu about managing the floods." 

Approaching Dayu, the River God asked, "Dayu, I heard you were commissioned to control the floods, traveling across mountains and rivers with your people to find a solution. Have you found it?" 

"I reviewed my father Gun's flood control methods and found that blocking the floods was not very effective. So, I've decided to try another approach—clearing the river channels to let the floodwaters flow into the East Sea," Dayu said, pointing to the Yellow River.
summary_zh: 河伯与乌龟来到大禹身边，询问其治水方法。大禹表示已放弃父亲鲧的堵截方式，决定采用疏通河道的方法引导洪水入海。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh:
“那么，你疏通了哪些河道？”
“实在惭愧，现在还没有开始疏通。我不太了解河流的
走向和地理情况，正带着大家丈量山川河流……”
这时，河伯拿出河图递给大禹，说：“看来，我画的河
图也许对你有些帮助，希望你能早日带领大家治好洪水。”
page_text_en:
"So, which river channels have you dredged?"
"I'm truly ashamed—I haven't even started yet. I don't fully understand the rivers' courses or the geography, and I'm currently leading everyone to measure mountains and rivers..."
At this moment, Hebo took out a river map and handed it to Dayu, saying, "It seems my drawn river map might be of some help to you. I hope you can soon lead everyone to control the floods."
summary_zh: 河伯询问大禹疏通了哪些河道，大禹表示尚未开始，正在勘测地形；河伯便拿出自己绘制的河图赠予大禹，希望助其治水。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh:
“太感谢您了！这正是我们急需的东西。”大禹高兴极了，他激动地用双手接过河图。
河图上详细地描绘了中原地方大小河道的流向和水势情况，能为大禹减少许多勘测的功夫。
大禹细细查看河图，再次弯腰道谢：“多谢河伯相助。”接着，他笑着问：“不知跟在您身边的可是神龟？”
page_text_en:
"Thank you so much! This is exactly what we need." Yu was overjoyed and eagerly took the River Map with both hands.
The map detailed the flow and water levels of rivers and streams in the Central Plains, which would save Yu a great deal of surveying work.
Yu carefully examined the map, bowed again, and said, "Thank you for your help, River Lord." Then, smiling, he asked, "Is the creature beside you the divine turtle?"
summary_zh: 大禹收到河伯赠送的河图，感激不已，并询问河伯身边的神龟。画面中，河伯将河图交给大禹，大禹仔细查看，旁边神龟探出头来。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh:
先平整土地，挖出新的河道，容纳漫延的洪水；然后治理高山，让洪水可以顺利地从山间流过；最后疏通积满淤泥的河道，让河水不再因为河道堵塞而漫出。

“它是黄河边的神龟，在这里生活几千年了。”河伯笑着摸了摸乌龟的脑袋。
在河图的指引下，大禹很快确定了治水的具体方案。
他决定把所有的山山水水当作一个整体来治理。
page_text_en:
First, level the land and dig new channels to contain the spreading floodwaters; then, manage the high mountains so that floods can flow smoothly through the valleys; finally, clear the river channels clogged with silt, so that rivers no longer overflow due to blockages.

"It's the divine turtle of the Yellow River, having lived here for thousands of years." Hebo smiled and patted the turtle's head.
Guided by the River Map, Dayu quickly determined a specific plan for flood control.
He decided to treat all mountains and rivers as a single, integrated system to manage.
summary_zh: 大禹在河伯和神龟的帮助下，根据河图制定了治水方案，决定将山川河流视为整体进行治理，并规划了平整土地、治理高山、疏通河道的具体步骤。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh:
应龙听说了大禹的计划，也来帮忙。
他拖着长长的尾巴，
在大禹划出的线上挖出了一道又一道深深的沟。

人们跟在后面，拿着石锹、带着簸箕，把应龙挖出来的土装好。
神龟便把装好的土运出去，填平地面的坑坑洼洼。
page_text_en:
Yinglong heard about Dayu's plan and came to help.
He dragged his long tail,
and dug deep trenches along the lines Dayu had marked.

People followed behind, holding shovels and carrying baskets, loading the soil dug out by Yinglong.
The divine turtle then carried the loaded soil away, filling in the pits and hollows on the ground.
summary_zh: 应龙协助大禹治水，用尾巴在规划线上挖掘深沟，人们随后用工具装土，神龟则将土运走并填平地面坑洼。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh:
就这样，一条条又宽又深的新河道
挖出来了，一块块平整的土地出现了。
大禹带着大家把洪水引入新的河道
里，洪水顺着河道快速地向东流去。
page_text_en:
In this way, one after another, wide and deep new channels were dug out, and piece after piece of flat land appeared.
Yu the Great led everyone to divert the floodwaters into the new channels,
and the floodwaters flowed rapidly eastward along the channels.
summary_zh: 大禹带领众人开挖新河道，将洪水引入其中，洪水顺着新河道向东流去，平坦的土地逐渐显现。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh: 可是，洪水流到龙门的时候，被高高的龙门山挡住，只能顺着山脚下一条狭窄的河道缓缓穿过。慢慢地，洪水又开始漫溢出来。大禹来到山上，望着漫溢的洪水，长长地叹了口气。
page_text_en: However, when the floodwaters reached Longmen, they were blocked by the tall Longmen Mountain and could only slowly pass through a narrow channel at the foot of the mountain. Gradually, the floodwaters began to overflow again. Dayu came to the mountain, looked at the overflowing floodwaters, and sighed deeply.
summary_zh: 洪水在龙门山前受阻，只能从狭窄河道通过，随后再次漫溢。大禹登上山头，望着泛滥的洪水，长叹一口气。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh:
他决定带着大家仔细地查看龙门山的地形。
不久，大禹发现必须要凿开这座山，洪水
才能顺利地流向东海。
可是，龙门山实在是太高太大了，要凿开
它实在是太难了。怎么办呢？
光呆在家里是想不出来的。大禹每天都在
山中勘测查看，想找出最省工省力的方法。
很快，大禹勘测到
了一段峡口，只要把这
里拓宽，洪水就能更快
地通过龙门山了！
page_text_en:
He decided to lead everyone to carefully examine the terrain of Longmen Mountain.
Soon, Dayu realized that this mountain must be carved open for the floodwaters to flow smoothly into the East Sea.
But Longmen Mountain was simply too high and too large; carving it open was extremely difficult. What should be done?
Just staying at home wouldn't lead to a solution. Dayu spent every day surveying and examining the mountain, trying to find the most efficient and effortless method.
Soon, Dayu surveyed and found
a narrow gorge. If this
area were widened, the floodwaters could pass through Longmen Mountain much faster!
summary_zh: 大禹带领众人勘察龙门山地形，发现必须凿开此山才能让洪水顺利东流，但山体高大难以开凿。他每日在山中勘测，最终发现一处峡口，只要拓宽此处，洪水就能更快通过。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh: 就这样，大禹带着大家在龙门山的峡口处只开了八十步宽的口子，便顺利地把洪水引出去了。
page_text_en: Thus, Yu the Great, along with everyone, opened a gap eighty paces wide at the pass of Longmen Mountain, and successfully diverted the floodwaters away.
summary_zh: 大禹带领众人在龙门山峡口开凿八十步宽的通道，成功将洪水引走。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
page_text_ocr_zh:
大禹废寝忘食地治理洪水，连着三次路过家门都没回一次家。十三年过去了，他率领着大家勘测了九州土地，疏导了九条河道，修治了九个大湖，最终治好了洪水。

接着，大禹开始治理淤塞的河道。大家一起挖出河里的淤泥，抬出堵住河道的石块。河道不堵了，水就顺利地流向大海啦！
page_text_en:
Dayu worked tirelessly to control the floods, passing by his home three times without returning once. After thirteen years, he led everyone to survey the nine provinces, dredge nine rivers, and repair nine lakes, finally taming the floods.

Next, Dayu began clearing the clogged river channels. Everyone worked together to dig out the silt from the rivers and carry away the rocks blocking the channels. With the rivers unblocked, the water flowed smoothly toward the sea!
summary_zh: 本页描述大禹十三年治水的艰辛与成果，他带领众人疏通河道、清除淤泥和石块，最终使洪水顺利流向大海。

title_en: Yu the Great Tames the Floods
summary_zh: 画面中，大禹站在高处，身旁有一只神龟探出头来，背景为山石与水流，表现大禹治水过程中与神龟的互动场景。
